headline: Pakistan's information ministry on Saturday rebuked Afghan Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid's remarks, saying the Taliban's persistent refusal to address terrorism from Afghan soil remains the principal obstacle to normal relations, Dawn reports.

card.desc: Dehshatgardi se inkaar ta'luqat mein sab se bari rukawat

caption:
Pakistan ka Afghan Taliban ko sakht jawab!
Dawn ke mutabiq Saturday ko information ministry ne Afghan Taliban spokesperson Zabihullah Mujahid ke Hurriyat Radio interview par jawab dete hue kaha ke Afghan sarzameen se dehshatgardi ko address karne se Taliban ka musalsal inkaar hi normal ta'luqat mein sab se bari rukawat hai. Ministry ke mutabiq dehshatgardi red line hai aur shehriyon ki security par koi samjhauta nahi.
